newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bodies found after Algerian forces kill two in car.
newsitem.headline: Bodies found after Algerian forces kill two in car.

text.p: Algerian security forces killed two Moslem fundamentalists and found the bodies of two elderly people, knifed to death in the car, and the passport of a Bulgarian slain in Algiers, El Watan newspaper said on Sunday.
El Watan, well informed on security matters, said troops on routine patrol in Bainem forest on the heights of Algiers came under fire when they signalled the car to stop last week.
They killed the "two terrorists" and then discovered the bodies of a couple who owned the car inside the vehicle.

The passport of Evtim Evtimov, a 56-year-old Bulgarian businessman killed last month in an Algiers suburb, was recovered from one of the fundamentalists' bodies. Guns, walkie-talkie radios and subversive documents were found during a later search of the forest, El Watan said.
